title: Cobblemon Explorer’s Atlas
description: A Pokémon-inspired adventure modpack featuring Cobblemon, expanded exploration, and improved world generation for deeper survival gameplay. Catch, battle, and journey through beautifully crafted biomes with enhanced progression.
body: This modpack combines Cobblemon with exploration and quality-of-life mods. It includes Improved World Generation for better terrain, Backpacks for extra storage, and Exploration Improvements to make traveling more rewarding. The focus is on catching and training Cobblemon while surviving in an enhanced world.
